Alphabetical Index of 6 Labels for 7 IPIP Scales


Each construct listed below is followed by links to those IPIP scales that seem to measure that same construct.

Anxiety (NEO: N1), (CAT-PD: Anxiousness)
Diligence (HEX: C-Dili)
Friendliness (NEO: E1)
Integrity/Honesty/Authenticity (VIA: Int)
Orderliness (NEO: C2), (HEX: C-Orga)
Extraversion (NEO Domain)

Footnote: NEO = the NEO-PI-R; HEX = the HEXACO-PI.
